description_for_model: Search and browse 6,500+ rental properties in Da Nang, Vietnam. Filter by area, price range, property type (apartment, house, villa, studio), and bedrooms. Returns real-time pricing in VND with availability status. Covers all Da Nang districts: An Thuong/My An, Son Tra, Hai Chau, Ngu Hanh Son, Thanh Khe, Lien Chieu, Cam Le. Data aggregated from Facebook, Airbnb, Cho Tot, and local platforms, translated to English.
description_for_human: Find rental apartments, houses, and villas in Da Nang, Vietnam. Search 6,500+ listings by area, price, and property type.
